storyNotes: 31 adult gulls from the Zeebrugge/Belgian-Dutch North Sea coast colonies, hourly fixes, 15 Jul - 30 Nov 2015.
18 birds reach south of 38 N (Iberia/Morocco) and 4 cross south of 30 N into the Sahara/West Africa; furthest south L909887 at 14.0 N, L910935 at 20.7 N, L909648 at 23.6 N.
Southbound departures (first fix south of 45 N) spread from 05 Aug to 27 Nov, median 19 Oct.
On 30 Nov, 23 of 31 birds are south of 41 N; 5 sit in the Gulf of Cadiz / Guadalquivir area of SW Spain and 6 are still in the Channel / North Sea (resident or late migrants).
All birds are adults (no juveniles) tagged at known colonies, so start points are shared and routes can be compared by similarity clustering.
